# YourGP@Lyneham — Full Site Content

> General practice in Lyneham, Canberra — Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence.

---

## Home

A very warm welcome to YourGP@Lyneham.

Our practice vision is 'Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence'.

The best medicine is provided in the context of a long-term relationship with your GP. This relationship allows your GP to grow in understanding of who you are, your medical history and what is important to you. In this setting your GP can best tailor treatment to you and your circumstances, caring for you as a whole person. You can grow in trust of your GP, in their knowledge and genuine care for you and your family. Many GPs have established relationships with patients that cover decades. Some have the privilege of caring for four generations of the same family. These are relationships your GP would like to build with you.

Your GP provides clinical excellence through:
- Staying up to date with advances in medicine
- Fully computerised records and other technologies to support comprehensive care
- Continuing practice quality improvements
- Teaching the next generation of doctors by participating in the training of medical students and new GPs

Most importantly, your GP wishes to take the time to listen and explain. Your GP aims for people to leave with questions answered and a better understanding of their own health.

### Opening Hours

**Lyneham**: Monday to Thursday 8:00am–6:00pm, Friday 8:00am–12:00pm

### Locations

- YourGP@Lyneham — 62 Brigalow St, Lyneham ACT 2602 (next to Tilley's cafe)

## Services

### Children's Health
Paediatrics is a special interest of the GPs. Kids love to visit. The GPs and nurses all enjoy seeing children.

### Childhood Immunisations
GPs and nurses are supportive of childhood vaccinations. They are safe and an effective way to protect your child. Immunisation records are uploaded electronically to the Australian Immunisation Register.

### Chronic Disease Management
GPs are highly experienced at helping patients with diabetes, heart disease, asthma, COPD, mental health conditions and other chronic diseases.

### Driver's Medicals
Commercial driving medical assessments require a double length appointment. For non-commercial licences for chronic medical conditions book a standard appointment.

### Men's Health
Check-ups, erectile dysfunction, incontinence, vasectomy, mental health, STI screens. For more information on vasectomies, please see the vasectomy section.

### Mental Health
Depression, anxiety, postnatal depression, schizophrenia, grief, bipolar depression and PTSD. A mental health care plan (referral to a psychologist) requires a double appointment.

### Minor Procedures
Implanon insertion and removal, IUD insertion and removal, skin cancer removal, tongue tie, ingrown toenail removal, vasectomy (Dr John Deery only). Not all procedures are done by all doctors — please call the practice.

### IUD Insertion
This involves a visit to discuss IUD suitability and then a separate appointment for insertion.

### Musculoskeletal
Diagnosis and assessment of all types of joint and muscle sprains and strains.

### Tongue Tie
Dr John Deery only. Tongue tie is a common condition of newborn children. It will sometimes cause newborns to have a lot of difficulty with breastfeeding. He can provide prompt assessment and treatment of the condition, on the same day, when appropriate. Lip tie concerns are common and will rarely need surgical correction. If concerned please book for assessment.

### Travel Vaccinations
Yellow fever vaccine is available at Denman and Crace. Please bring any previous immunisation records.

### Skin Checks
Skin checks require a long appointment. Please do not wear make-up.

### Vasectomy
Initial consult with Dr John Deery at either Lyneham or Denman. The procedure is performed at Crace only on Thursday and Friday mornings. See canberravasectomy.com.au for more information.

### Women's Health
Check-ups, pap smears, STI screens, breast check, contraceptive advice, implanon insertion and removal, IUD insertion, menopause, pregnancy planning, shared antenatal care and postnatal check-ups.

### Workers Compensation
Payment is required at the time of your appointment. Standard consultation charges apply. Your insurer will reimburse you.

### Allied Health

**Nursing**: Immunisations, ear syringe, wound management, health assessments, ECG, iron infusions, diabetes clinics, health assessments and chronic disease care plans. Bookings only available by calling reception.

**4Cyte Pathology**: Located next door. Opening hours: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 7:30am–2:00pm, Tuesday 8:00am–11:00am.

---

## New Patient

### Your first visit at YourGP@Lyneham

Save time waiting in the practice by completing your new patient registration online via HotDoc. Please arrive at least ten minutes early to your first appointment. This will give you sufficient time to fill out forms and for reception to create your new patient file.

### Billing and Appointments

Payment is required at time of consultation. The GPs do not bulk bill.

All Workers Compensation cases are required to pay at time of consultation. Third Party (case conference) consultations will be billed to the insurer if there is an accepted claim number.

If a procedure or any other type of appointment is made then fees will be advised prior.

GPs reserve some appointments daily for urgent bookings. You can secure an 'on the day' appointment by booking online from midnight or by calling from 8:00am.

If you wish to cancel your appointment please give as much notice as possible.

#### Fees

- Standard appointment: $117 ($107 for pensioners)
- Longer appointment: $213 ($193 for pensioners)

#### Saturday Fees (at YourGP@Crace)

- Standard appointment: $146
- Longer appointment: $240

### After Hours

Practice opening hours are 8am to 6pm Monday to Thursday, 8am to 12pm Friday.

For attention outside these hours please call CALMS on 1300 422 567. CALMS (Canberra Afterhours Locum Service) is staffed by experienced Canberra GPs. It is a not for profit organisation that has been operating since 1971. When you call you will speak with a nurse who will triage your medical problem. CALMS clinics operate until 11pm at North Canberra Hospital Bruce and The Canberra Hospital. After 11pm a doctor is available to visit at home if you need urgent attention.

Healthdirect — 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. If you have a health issue and you do not know who to contact or what to do, a registered nurse will help direct you. Phone 1800 022 222.

Walk-in Nurse Centres — 7:30am to 10pm. No appointment needed.

---

## FAQ

### Making Appointments
It is easy to book online via HotDoc. If you wish to call, please advise which practice you would like to visit and your preferred GP. Your usual GP prefers to see you for continuity of care. If your usual GP is not available, you are welcome to see another GP at Crace, Denman or Lyneham — they will have full access to your computer record. Book a long appointment if you think your visit will require longer than fifteen minutes. Missed appointments without notice will attract a $50 fee.

### Urgent Bookings
A proportion of appointments are reserved for urgent bookings each day. You can secure an 'on the day' appointment by booking online after midnight or by calling from 8am. When fully booked, you can request a fit-in appointment.

### Billing
Payment is required at the time of consultation. The GPs do not bulk bill. Saturday standard appointments are $146 and long appointments $240. All Workers' Compensation/Third Party cases are required to pay at the consultation time.

### Parking
There is plentiful parking around the Lyneham shops. There is also parking opposite Lyneham Primary School on Brigalow St. Alternately drive past the practice and turn right at the roundabout onto Wattle Street — there is all day parking on the right side of the street.

### Languages
English. A phone interpreter can be provided if necessary — please give a few days notice. Deaf patients can use the National Relay Service or Auslan interpreters.

### Confidentiality
Patient information is kept confidential. You may request the full privacy policy from reception.

### Medical Certificates
A medical certificate is a legal document. Certificates cannot be backdated. Certificates will not be issued unless your GP is consulted.

### Results
The majority of results are notified via SMS. Results are available online to view through MyHealthRecord or MyDHR. ACT Pathology results are available to view immediately through MyDHR or MyHealthRecord. Capital Pathology and Laverty Pathology results are available to view through MyHealthRecord 7 days after processing. 4Cyte Pathology are not currently sending results to MyHealthRecord.

### Contacting Your Doctor
Your GP can be contacted during business hours. Your GP will generally not take phone calls — you may leave a message.

### Repeat Prescriptions
Your GP requests that you attend for review for a repeat prescription. This is best practice medicine.

### E-Mail
E-mail to reception is not secure. To send a message to your doctor, use the contact form on the Contact page. Documents for your doctor can be sent to noreply@yourgpcanberra.com.au.

### Reminders
Your GP values preventative health care. You will be notified via SMS of reminders when due.

### After Hours Care
- CALMS (Canberra Afterhours Locum Medical Service): 1300 422 567
- Healthdirect (24/7 nurse helpline): 1800 022 222
- Walk-in Nurse Centres: 7:30am–10pm, no appointment needed

### Accreditation
Accredited with AGPAL (Australian General Practice Accreditation Limited).

### Teaching Practice
YourGP is a teaching practice. Third year medical students from the ANU sit in with GPs for six-week rotations, six times each year. GPs also teach and provide supervision to GP registrars. A registrar is a fully qualified doctor who is undertaking further training in General Practice. Registrars have several years postgraduate experience in the hospital system. General practice training involves two years of work under a GP supervisor.

### Suggestions or Complaints
Feedback is welcome via the contact form. If unresolved, complaints can be directed to the Community & Healthcare Complaints Commissioner, GPO Box 321, Canberra ACT 2601.

## Careers

YourGP is hiring GPs, nurses, and administrative staff across its practices.

### For GPs
YourGP as your chosen service entity strives to provide the best administrative and nursing support to GPs to enable you to focus on providing the best care for your patients. GPs are sole traders who conduct their own business and see their own patients. YourGP does not have the capacity for Level 1 Supervision for overseas trained doctors.

### For Nurses
The nursing team is integral to the high level of care provided to patients and GPs. Nursing roles are varied with a mixture of jobs throughout the day and a lot of face-to-face patient time. Nurses provide health coaching to patients and have excellent relationships with patients and clinicians.

### For Admin
The GPs saw over 100,000 patients last year. A lot of support is required for the clinical team. Qualities that will see you win: helping others with care and excellence while always looking to improve.
